title: D latch · LATQ1_X1R
imageAlt: Grayscale D latch · LATQ1_X1R standard-cell layout in 40 nm
subtitle: Follows the input while enabled, then holds the last value.
purpose: A D latch stores one bit. While gate/enable G is active, output Q follows data input D. When G becomes inactive, Q holds the last value. This makes the latch level-sensitive.
contribution: Custom standard-cell layout shown in the original project screenshot.
verification: Original layout supplied. Cell-specific verification reports are not displayed here.

title: D flip-flop · DFFQ_X1R
imageAlt: Grayscale D flip-flop · DFFQ_X1R standard-cell layout in 40 nm
subtitle: Captures one bit on a clock edge and holds it between edges.
purpose: A D flip-flop stores one bit by sampling data input D at the active edge of clock CK. Output Q holds that value until the next active clock edge. Unlike a latch, it is edge-triggered; flip-flops are used in registers and synchronous logic.
contribution: Custom standard-cell layout shown in the original project screenshot.
verification: Original layout supplied. Cell-specific verification reports are not displayed here.
